Resumen:
We continue to investigate degraded payment conversion on Transbank (Chile). Approval rate on completed transactions remains within nominal range. The impact continues to be driven by an elevated rate of transactions not reaching a final state within the expected processing window. Root cause analysis remains in progress with the processor. Next update to follow.
